'''Sheepshead Bay''' is a neighborhood in southern [[Brooklyn]], [[New York City]]. It is bounded by [[Ocean Parkway (Brooklyn)|Ocean Parkway]] to the west; [[Kings Highway (Brooklyn)|Kings Highway]] to the north; [[Nostrand Avenue]] and Gerritsen Avenue to the east; and the [[Atlantic Ocean]] to the south. Sheepshead Bay is abutted by the neighborhoods of [[Brighton Beach]], [[Manhattan Beach, Brooklyn|Manhattan Beach]], [[Coney Island]] and [[Homecrest, Brooklyn|Homecrest]], to the west; [[Midwood]] to the north; and [[Gerritsen Beach]] to the east.

The neighborhood is named after a bay that separates mainland Brooklyn from the eastern portion of [[Coney Island]] & the Southern portion of [[Manhattan Beach, Brooklyn|Manhattan Beach]] & [[Brighton Beach]] which was originally one of the [[Outer Barrier]] islands but is now a peninsula. The mouth of the bay is about {{convert|1.0|mi|km}} southwest of [[Marine Park]].

Sheepshead Bay is part of [[Brooklyn Community Board 15|Brooklyn Community District 15]], and its primary [[ZIP Code]]s are 11229 and 11235.<ref name="NYCPlanning"/> It is patrolled by the 61st Precinct of the [[New York City Police Department]].<ref name="NYPD 61st Precinct"/> Politically it is represented by the [[New York City Council]]'s 46th and 48th Districts.
